title: Compositional Temporal Grounding With Structured Variational Cross-Graph Correspondence Learning

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: To systematically measure the compositional generalizability of temporal grounding models, we introduce a new Compositional Temporal Grounding task and construct two new dataset splits, i.e., Charades-CG and ActivityNet-CG.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: A natural solution to this problem is to utilize the systematic compositionality [4, 9, 31] of human language, which allows us to form novel compositions by combining known words in novel ways to describe unseen activities (i.e. compositional generalization).

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: To tackle this challenge, we propose a variational cross-graph reasoning framework that explicitly decomposes video and language into multiple structured hierarchies and learns fine-grained semantic correspondence among them.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: These methods [10, 32,45,47] mainly encode both sentence and video segments into unstructured global representations, respectively, and then devise specific cross-modal interaction modules to fuse them for final prediction.

methods.name: Memory, Graph, or Structure Alignment
